installer.title: Filee Rust Setup
installer.welcome.fresh: Setup installs Filee Rust {0} on this computer.
installer.welcome.update:
Filee Rust {0} is installed.
Setup updates it to {1}; your settings, presets and engines stay as they are.
installer.welcome.license: Filee Rust is free and open source (MIT license), based on Filee by Filee contributors.
installer.options.space: Filee Rust needs about {0} of disk space.
installer.task.allusers: Install for all users (needs administrator rights; Filee Rust can only update itself when it is installed for you alone)
installer.task.startup: Start Filee Rust when I sign in to Windows
installer.task.sevenzip: 7-Zip (extract and pack ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR and ISO disc images; included, no download)
installer.task.engineupdate: Update the conversion engines weekly (silently; only while nothing converts and not on battery)
installer.engines.group: Download conversion engines (Filee's own downloader, checked, no admin rights). Images, data, 2D CAD (DXF/DWG) and PDF are built in; Microsoft Office converts Office documents first when it is installed and works:
installer.engine.libreoffice: LibreOffice (open-source office suite: Office documents when Microsoft Office can't, old and OpenDocument files; ~422 MB)
installer.engine.tesseract: Tesseract (OCR: scans to searchable PDF; ~50 MB)
installer.engine.pandoc: Pandoc (Markdown engine: Markdown to and from Word, HTML, EPUB, LaTeX; ~42 MB)
installer.engine.ghostscript: Ghostscript (EPS, PS, old AI vector files; ~19 MB)
installer.original_filee:
The original Filee is installed too. Running both makes two donuts appear for every Ctrl-drag.

Uninstall the original Filee in Settings > Apps afterwards (settings and presets stay; Filee Rust uses the same ones). Setup asks the original Filee to exit now.
installer.done.title: Filee Rust is ready
installer.done.text:
Filee Rust runs in the notification area of the taskbar, and its settings window opens now.

To convert files, hold Ctrl and drag them in File Explorer, or press Ctrl+Alt+Space on the selected files, or right-click them and choose Convert with Filee.
installer.done.updated: Filee Rust is updated. Your settings, presets and engines are as they were.
installer.done.engines: The conversion engines you picked download in the background.
installer.warning.runtime:
{0} can't run: it needs the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime ({1}), which this computer doesn't have. To fix it, install Microsoft's Visual C++ Redistributable (x64):
{2}
installer.error.title: Filee Rust was not installed
installer.error.uninstall_title: Filee Rust was not removed completely
installer.error.space: There isn't enough free space on {0}: Filee Rust needs {1}, but only {2} is free.
installer.error.damaged: This setup file is damaged. Download it again.
installer.error.incomplete: This setup file is incomplete, probably because the download didn't finish. Download it again.
installer.error.files: Setup couldn't write Filee Rust's files: {0}
installer.error.windows: Filee Rust needs 64-bit Windows 10 version 1809 or later.
installer.error.rolled_back: Setup put everything back: the previous Filee Rust still works.
installer.uninstall.title: Uninstall Filee Rust
installer.uninstall.text:
This removes Filee Rust {0} from this computer, with its start-at-sign-in entry and its File Explorer menu entry.

Your settings, presets and the engines Filee downloaded stay.
installer.uninstall.done: Filee Rust is no longer on this computer.
installer.uninstall.settings_kept: Your settings stay, for when you install Filee Rust again.
installer.uninstall.not_installed: Filee Rust is not installed in {0}.
